_comment: Latest published version per platform. The game fetches this from the canonical Pages URL and prompts a stale client to update. 'web' is auto-synced to config.js VERSION by scripts/build-pages.py on every build. 'android' and 'steam' are bumped BY HAND only when that store release actually goes live (so a web-only push never nags store users about a version they can't get yet).
